record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The LORD<WH03068> said<WH05002><WTH8803> unto my Lord<WH0113>, Sit<WH03427><WTH8798> thou at my right hand<WH03225>, until I make<WH07896><WTH8799> thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> thy footstool<WH01916><WH07272>.
